test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who is regarded as the father of Qawwali in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amir Khosrow.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The full name of Hazrat Amir Khusrau was **Abu'l Hasan Yamīn ud-Dīn Khusrau.**
 
• **He was an Indo-Persian Sufi singer, musician, poet and scholar who lived under the Delhi Sultanate.**
 
• He was a disciple of Nizamuddin Auliya of Delhi.
 
• **He is also known as 'father of Qawwali',** 'Parrot of India' and also referred as 'father of Urdu Literature'.
 
• Amir Khusrau was the **court poet of Alauddin Khilji.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hazrat Ali was a cousin, son-in-law and companion of the Islamic prophet Muhammad**. He was killed by ibn Muljam, who wanted revenge for the Battle of Nahrawan.
 
• Hazrat Nizamuddin was an sunni muslim scholar, contemporary to Ghiyas-ud-din tughluq.
 
• **Hazrat Nizamuddin Aulia was the teacher of Amir Khusrau. His tomb is in Delhi.**
 
• Hazrat Shahenshahwali also known as Hussain Shah Wali was a sufi saint of Golkonda during the reign of Qutb-Sahi Dynasty. He died in 1620.
